verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gumloop acting as an MCP client (connecting its agents out to external MCP servers) and offering 'Hosted MCPs' infrastructure where customers build and deploy their own MCP servers, but there is no evidence of Gumloop itself publishing an official first-party MCP server that external agents (e.g., Claude, Cursor) can connect to in order to use Gumloop's own platform tools. missing for 10: an official Gumloop-hosted MCP server endpoint exposing Gumloop's own capabilities to external agents, documentation of connecting to it, and any independent/hands-on confirmation.
